import_history.name: Import historical statistics
import_history.description: Imports hourly statistics derived from the stored five-minute Airthings readings. Existing hours are updated.

backfill_entity_history.name: Backfill recent entity history
backfill_entity_history.description: Replays the most recent 30 days of five-minute samples into the existing sensor entities using their original timestamps. Requires Recorder retention of at least 30 days.

user.title: Connect to Airthings Local
user.description: Enter the base URL of your Airthings API, for example http://192.168.1.50:8000.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to the API or no enabled devices were found.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. Check the Home Assistant logs.

abort.already_configured: This Airthings API is already configured.
abort.cannot_connect: The discovered API could not be reached.

init.title: Automatic history backfill
init.description: Choose how often automatic backfill runs. The lookback period is automatically set to one hour longer than the interval.
